title: Differential of group addition at the identity
statement: Let G be a group scheme [def-sc-group-scheme] over a field k with identity e and addition m:G\times G\to G. Under the canonical identification T_{G\times G/k,(e,e)}\cong T_{G/k,e}\oplus T_{G/k,e}, the tangent map dm_{(e,e)} sends (v,w) to v+w.

proof.text: Apply the canonical product tangent-space isomorphism (Tag 0BEB, field case) to X=Y=G and the k-rational points x=y=e. It identifies T_{G x_k G/k,(e,e)} with T_{G/k,e} direct-sum T_{G/k,e}; the two summand inclusions are induced by (1,e) and (e,1).

Let i_1=(1,e):G \to G \times_k G and i_2=(e,1):G \to G \times_k G. Since m composed with i_1 and m composed with i_2 are the identity by the group-scheme unit laws, functoriality of tangent maps gives dm composed with di_1 = id and dm composed with di_2 = id. Under the product identification from step 1, di_1(v)=(v,0) and di_2(w)=(0,w).
The tangent map dm is k-linear by the tangent-map linearity lemma. Therefore dm(v,w)=dm((v,0)+(0,w))=dm(v,0)+dm(0,w)=v+w, using step 2. This is the asserted formula.
